name: playtime
title: Playtime
description: Quickly check the total time played of any game in your Steam library
author: tamag0tcha

commands.name: check-playtime
commands.title: Playtime
commands.description: Search and check playtime for games in your Steam library

preferences.name: steamId
preferences.title: Steam ID (Optional)
preferences.description: Your Steam ID (64-bit). Auto-detected if Steam is installed. Only needed if auto-detection fails or for API fallback.

preferences.name: steamApiKey
preferences.title: Steam API Key (Optional)
preferences.description: Only needed if your Steam profile is private. Get one at https://steamcommunity.com/dev/apikey (use 'localhost' for domain)
